crossRefs.note: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

people.name: Attai
people.line: Grandson of Sheshan, descendant of Judah

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Son of Attai, from the tribe of Judah.

translations.web: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,
translations.bsb: Attai was the father of Nathan, Nathan was the father of Zabad,
translations.kjv: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
translations.asv: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
